boundary: Every observed X2 failure is retained before retry and receives zero evidence credit.

negatives.failure: A bounded inspection timed out while counting lines across the new X2 implementation files.
negatives.recovery: Split metadata, status, and syntax inspection into independently bounded probes.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine line-count reads with status and syntax checks in one short Windows wrapper.

negatives.failure: Windows PowerShell 5.1 rejected a direct pipeline from a foreach statement before execution.
negatives.recovery: Assign foreach output to an array and pipe the completed array separately.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell 5.1 foreach statement.

negatives.failure: A single-file text search exceeded its ten-second bound without producing evidence.
negatives.recovery: Use a longer but still bounded native exact-pattern probe for the known file.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not infer Windows inspection latency solely from the apparent size of a file.

negatives.failure: The first exact-surface preflight omitted all ten frozen family-current runner filenames from its allowlist.
negatives.recovery: Build the script allowlist from the exact runner names frozen in the X1 definitions.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Derive generated-runner validation scope from the frozen runner ledger rather than a guessed filename prefix.
